transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I guess I'm here because of some family stuff. It's my husband’s sister. She's... she's been working this family business so she can get control of the money. Trying to push me out of the decisions. 

People keep trying to smooth it over, tell me it's fine, but... I'm not blind. I know what I’ve been seeing for more than a year now.
Can you tell me more about what you think your husband's sister is doing with the business and how you know she's trying to push you out?

Well... like I just said, she's working things so she gets control of the money. She wants me out of all the decisions. 

I don't... I don't really want to get into all the little details right now. But I just know. I've been seeing it for more than a year now. Other folks try to smooth it over and act like it's fine, but... I know what I'm seeing.
Have you ever experienced a period of time where you felt unusually down, hopeless, or lost interest in things for several days or more?
No... no, I haven't. I just... I feel fine that way. I'm just dealing with this family stuff, that's all.
Do you often feel like people are against you or that you're being targeted in some way?

I wouldn't say people in general. Just... just her. Like I said before, she's trying to push me out of the family business and take control of the money. I know she is. I don't really want to keep going over it, but... I've been seeing it for over a year. I'm not making it up, no matter what anyone else says.
Do you have any other beliefs or concerns, besides those about your husband’s sister, that others might find unusual or hard to believe?

No... no, I don't. It's just... just what I told you about her. That's all. I don't know why everyone keeps trying to make this into something else. I just want to run the business like we always have.
Do you believe that your husband's sister's actions are part of a real, tangible plot against you, or do you sometimes think these things might not be exactly as they seem?

I... I know what I've been seeing. It's real. She's been working the business to get control of the money and push me out. I've been watching it happen for more than a year now. I don't care how folks try to smooth it over or... or say it's not what it looks like. I know what she's doing.
Do you believe that your husband's sister has taken specific actions, beyond just making business decisions, to try to harm you or control the family's finances?
No... I haven't noticed anything else. Just... just what she's doing with the business. I don't really know what else you mean by harm me. It's just the money and the business, like I said.
Do you find yourself mistrusting others outside of this situation with your husband’s sister, such as friends, coworkers, or other family members?
No. Just her. I don't... I don't have problems with anyone else. It's just what she's doing.
Do you ever feel that your husband's sister is acting with malicious intent toward you, even when there's no clear evidence to support that belief?
I don't... I don't know about malicious intent. I just know what she's doing with the business. That's all.
Do you feel that your husband's sister is deceiving others or betraying the family in specific ways related to the business, even if there's no clear proof of this?
I don't... I don't know about all that. I'm not saying she's tricking everybody else or anything. I just... I see what's happening with the accounts. I don't really know about the rest of it.
Have there been times in the past when you felt suspicious or mistrustful of someone else, even when others didn't share that concern?
No... I don't think so. I've never really had a reason to be. I just... I mind my own business, mostly.
Do you believe, without any doubt, that your husband's sister is intentionally manipulating the business to take control of the money, even if there’s no clear evidence to support this belief?

I... yes. I mean, I know what I see. She's working the family business so she can get control of the money. And push me out. People try to smooth it over, tell me I'm wrong, but... I know what I've been seeing. It's been going on for more than a year now. I just know it.
Even though you said you trust others, do you sometimes feel like there are hidden things going on that only you can see, which no one else seems to notice?

I don't... I don't really know what you mean by that. Hidden things? No. I just... I just pay attention to what's going on with the business. That's all. I don't go looking for secrets everywhere else.
Are there times when you feel certain about something being wrong, even when there’s no real proof and others can’t see what you see?

I... I'm not sure what you're asking. I told you why I'm here. It's my husband's sister. She's... she's working the family business to get control of the money. To push me out of any decisions. I don't need proof when I can see it happening. People try to smooth it over, but... I know what I've been seeing for over a year now. I just know.
Do you believe your husband's sister is deceiving or betraying the family in her actions with the business, even if you don't have clear proof?

Yes. I... I already told you this. She's working the business to get control of the money. And to push me out. I don't care how much folks try to smooth it over, or... or tell me I'm wrong. I know what I've been seeing. It's been more than a year. I just know.

Do you believe, without any doubt, that your husband’s sister is trying to take control of the family business and push you out, even though others don’t share this belief and there may be no clear evidence to support it?

I... yes. I mean, I've already said all this. I don't know why we keep going over it. I came here because of her... because of what she's doing with the business. She wants the money. She wants me out. People can say whatever they want, try to smooth it over or say there's no proof... but I know what I've seen. It's been going on for over a year. I don't have any doubts.
Even though others don’t see it and there may be no clear evidence, do you believe, completely without doubt, that your husband’s sister is trying to take control of the business and push you out?

Look... I just answered this. Yes. I know what she's doing with the family business. She wants the money and she wants me out of the decisions. I've been watching it happen for over a year now. I don't... I really don't know how many different ways you want me to say it.
